newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan shipbuilders boost production capacity.
newsitem.headline: Japan shipbuilders boost production capacity.

text.p: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to resume operating one of the shipbuilding slipways at its Kobe plant as early as the summer of 1998.
Another Japanese shipbuilder, Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries Co Ltd, also said on Wednesday it had boosted production capacity at its Tokyo plant to 26,500 tonnes from 25,500 tonnes.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily said on Wednesday that Japan's major shipbuilders are planning to boost production amid their rising international competitiveness.

The Japanese shipbuilders will be able to compete with their South Korean counterparts on ship prices even if the dollar weakens to 100 yen because of restructuring efforts such as reducing staff and rationalising facilities, the paper said.
Spokesmen for the companies said that the moves were decided upon obtaining the government's approval.
